title: Upgrade Difference Charge Computation for Monthly-Billed Rental Contracts
content:
The upgrade difference charge for a monthly-billed Rental Property Service Contracts contract moved to a higher tier part-way through a billing period is billed as one upgrade charge for the rest of that period. It is the monthly difference times the days left after the upgrade divided by 30, rounded to the cent once at the end.

**The monthly difference.** The new tier's base monthly amount less the old tier's base monthly amount, each being the tier's monthly premium plus its additional-unit premium for each unit beyond the first, reduced by the term's portfolio discount rate.
- The new tier is the tier the contract now holds; its figures are those on the product's premium rate card.
- The old tier is the prior tier on the contract, with these figures: Bridgewell Rental Appliance $42.99; Bridgewell Rental Systems $47.99; Bridgewell Rental Combo $64.99; Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo $69.99 plus $39.99 for each unit beyond the first.

**The term's portfolio discount rate.** For an upgrade difference charge the term's portfolio discount rate is the rate recorded on the installment for the term's first billing period, instead of counting the portfolio again, and only for such a charge; every other premium remains under the portfolio discount terms.

**The days left after the upgrade.** The calendar days after the upgrade date and before the start of the first billing period at the new tier. The upgrade date is the plan change date on the contract; the first billing period at the new tier is the latest monthly installment period in the billing history.

## Worked examples (hypothetical contracts, one unit, term's first installment recording 0.05)

1. Bridgewell Rental Systems to Bridgewell Rental Combo on 3 May; first period at the new tier starts 15 May. Days left: 4 to 14 May, 11 days. Monthly difference: $64.99 less $47.99 is $17.00, reduced by 0.05, $16.15. Charge: $16.15 times 11 divided by 30 is $5.92167, rounded once: **$5.92**.
2. Bridgewell Rental Appliance to Bridgewell Rental Systems on 26 April; first period at the new tier starts 15 May. Days left: 27 April to 14 May, 18 days. Monthly difference: $5.00 reduced by 0.05, $4.75. Charge: $4.75 times 18 divided by 30, **$2.85**.
